text: Thinking, David cannot: Or, saying, David shall not etc.
Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house: Or, because he had said even the blind and the lame, He shall not come into the house
went on, and grew: Heb. went, going and growing
Masons: Heb. hewers of the stone of the wall
Baalperazim: that is, the plain of breaches
burnt them: Or, took them away
